component.name: ProcHarbor
component.summary: Native Linux task manager and system monitor

description.p: ProcHarbor is a lightweight, responsive task manager and system monitor for Linux built in Rust. It provides deep system visibility and Windows Task Manager parity.

ul.li: Process hierarchy grouped by app, background, and system categories
Accurate Proportional Set Size (PSS) memory accounting
Compact real-time CPU, Memory, Disk, Wi-Fi, and GPU performance monitoring
Hardware memory detection (LPDDR5/DDR4/DDR5, speed, manufacturer, slots used)
Startup application management (enable/disable XDG autostart and systemd user services)
Systemd services manager with filter and status controls
Fast search, process termination, and low resource footprint

description.p: Ultra-compact UI redesign with high information density, Python wheel distribution, Flatpak support, and hardware memory detection.
